# llms.txt

Website information is generated from the project's immutable keyword and homepage SEO copy map.

## Public content

Allow: /
Allow: /pricing
Allow: /terms
Allow: /privacy

## Crawler guidance

- The homepage is the primary product explanation, feature, workflow, FAQ, and conversion resource.
- Generated metadata, structured data, captions, and media descriptions must match the visible homepage copy.
- The final brand assets are `/logo.webp`, `/favicon.ico`, and `/share-img.png`.

Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /sign-in
Disallow: /sign-up
Disallow: /profile
